firm_data.firm_description: Fitzpatrick & Hunt serves clients in diverse areas such as aviation and aerospace, general product liability and labor law. Our team of lawyers aggressively handle matters and complex litigation on a wide spectrum of issues from space transportation to environmental and toxic tort matters, intellectual property, insurance/reinsurance, and commercial disputes of all kinds, bringing our many decades of experience to everything we do.
notable_facts: Offices in New York City, Los Angeles, Princeton, NJ, Stamford, CT and Chicago, IL

email.subject: AI for Fitzpatrick, Hunt & Pagano, LLP - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Ralph,

Managing complex aviation and aerospace litigation across five offices takes precision and resources. We work with 28-attorney firms like yours that demand BigLaw-caliber work without the overhead.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing those exact demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of mid-market practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now meeting regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your New York office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping firms like Fitzpatrick & Hunt compete at scale.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
